text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building Python-based AI solutions.

I can help create the female AI avatar you described, including the realistic look, lip movement for later voiceover, and separate clips showing the full range of emotions you listed: sad, happy, mad, annoyed, laughing hard, giggling, and frustrated. I understand you want her styled with a brunette look, blue eyes, blush on the cheeks, cute gaming headphones, seated in a gaming chair, and framed against a green or blue screen for clean editing. I’d also make sure the output is organized so you can use each emotion clip individually.

My background is strongest in Python, machine learning, NLP, and model workflows, so I’m comfortable working through a structured visual generation task like this and keeping the deliverables clean and consistent. I’ve also built production systems that required reliable automation and careful output handling.

One project I’d highlight is the Support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co., a SaaS client. I built a classifier that routes incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served by FastAPI, with nightly retraining run through a Celery worker on Redis. That system reached a macro-F1 of 0.88 compared with 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and it reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

If you’d like, I can start by confirming the exact visual style references you want matched most closely, then work through the avatar setup and the emotion clips in an organized way. If there are any technical preferences for the final video format or background color, I’m happy to follow them.
